notes: eDPF (Tesouro estoquedpf.csv, Mercado) where available; BCB SGS 'posicao em carteira' elsewhere.
N = SGS 10651 - 10650 (LTN + NTN-F); NTN-F has no own SGS series.
Before ~2005 N+F+R covers only 70-82% of the market stock (NTN-C, FX-linked, LFT-A/B); use the _mkt shares and a 2005+ sample as robustness.
NTN-B is zero before 2002-01 and NTN-F before 2005-02: share_R and share_N(NTN-F part) are structurally zero there, not missing.
Do not use DadosJoao stock_by_group_bcb_sgs.csv: its NTN-F is inferred from the 4177/4178 percentages and is negative in 2000-2004.
